Things to check

• Company name is taken from the folder name (yokulanding) → “Yoku”. Rename it in the header, footer and prompt line if that's wrong.
• Anything in [brackets] is a placeholder for a real fact: client logos, retest window, response time, email, legal name, next availability.
• The finding card is an illustrative SAMPLE, not a real client result.
• Sphere: hover to spin it faster, click to knock glyphs loose — they grow back. Accent colour, glyph density and spin speed are adjustable per board.
• Option B (below) is the same hero with the sphere centred, like the ThreeUI study, for comparison.
